data.naming_authority: The German Centre for Integrative Biodiversity Research (iDiv) Halle-Jena-Leipzig
data.title: Annual Bioclimatic Variables for USA at 1 km resolution from CHELSA V2.1
data.summary: A subset of the CHELSA V2.1 ( https://www.chelsa-climate.org/datasets ) climatic variables (tasmax, tasmin and prec) were aggregated to a monthly 1 km * 1 km resolution and clipped to USA. From those, annually bioclimatic variables were calculated: Mean Annual Near-Surface Air Temperature (bio01) Mean Diurnal Near-Surface Air Temperature Range (bio02) Isothermality (bio03) Temperature Seasonality (bio04) Mean Daily Maximum Near-Surface Air Temperature of the Warmest Month (bio05) Mean Daily Minimum Near-Surface Air Temperature of the Coldest Month (bio06) Annual Daily Mean Near-Surface Air Temperature Range (bio07) Mean Daily Near-Surface Air Temperature of the Wettest Quarter (bio08) Mean Daily Near-Surface Air Temperature of the Driest Quarter (bio09) Mean Daily Mean Near-Surface Air Temperature of the Warmest Quarter (bio10) Mean Daily Mean Near-Surface Air Temperature of the Quarter (bio11) Annual Precipitation (bio12) Precipitation of the Wettest Month (bio13) Precipitation of the Driest Month (bio14) Precipitation Seasonality (bio15) Mean Monthly Precipitation of the Wettest Quarter (bio16) Mean Monthly Precipitation of the Driest Quarter (bio17) Mean Monthly Precipitation of the Warmest Quarter (bio18) Mean Monthly Precipitation of the Coldest Quarter (bio19)
data.source: This data set is based on the CHELSA V2.1 data (https://www.chelsa-climate.org/datasets/chelsa_daily ; Karger, D. N. (2025). https://www.doi.org/10.16904/envidat.687 ) and was prepared using the R-packages terra (https://rspatial.github.io/terra/) and predicts (https://github.com/rspatial/predicts)

ebv_metric_1.:long_name: Mean annual temperature calculated as the average of mean monthly temperatures over the year

ebv_metric_2.:standard_name: Mean Diurnal Near-Surface Air Temperature Range (bio02)
ebv_metric_2.:long_name: Mean diurnal temperature range computed as the average of monthly (tasmax − tasmin)

ebv_metric_3.:long_name: Isothermality: 100 × (bio02 ÷ bio07); compares day–night variability to annual temperature range

ebv_metric_4.:long_name: Temperature seasonality given by the standard deviation of mean monthly temperatures

ebv_metric_5.:standard_name: Mean Daily Maximum Near-Surface Air Temperature of the Warmest Month (bio05)
ebv_metric_5.:long_name: Highest monthly mean of daily maximum temperatures (tasmax) across the year; indicates peak thermal conditions

ebv_metric_6.:standard_name: Mean Daily Minimum Near-Surface Air Temperature of the Coldest Month (bio06)
ebv_metric_6.:long_name: Lowest monthly mean of daily minimum temperatures (tasmin) across the year; characterizes winter cold intensity

ebv_metric_7.:standard_name: Annual Daily Mean Near-Surface Air Temperature Range (bio07)
ebv_metric_7.:long_name: Annual temperature range calculated as bio05 − bio06; measures amplitude between warmest and coldest months

ebv_metric_8.:standard_name: Mean Daily Near-Surface Air Temperature of the Wettest Quarter (bio08)
ebv_metric_8.:long_name: Average monthly mean temperature over the wettest 3-month period of the year

ebv_metric_9.:standard_name: Mean Daily Near-Surface Air Temperature of the Driest Quarter (bio09)
ebv_metric_9.:long_name: Average monthly mean temperature over the driest 3-month period of the year

ebv_metric_10.:standard_name: Mean Daily Mean Near-Surface Air Temperature of the Warmest Quarter (bio10)
ebv_metric_10.:long_name: Average monthly mean temperature over the warmest 3-month period of the year

ebv_metric_11.:standard_name: Mean Daily Mean Near-Surface Air Temperature of the Quarter (bio11)
ebv_metric_11.:long_name: Average monthly mean temperature over the coldest 3-month period of the year

ebv_metric_12.:long_name: Sum of monthly precipitation totals across the year

ebv_metric_15.:long_name: Coefficient of variation (100 × SD ÷ mean) of monthly precipitation totals

ebv_metric_16.:standard_name: Mean Monthly Precipitation of the Wettest Quarter (bio16)
ebv_metric_16.:long_name: Average monthly precipitation during the wettest 3-month period of the year

ebv_metric_17.:standard_name: Mean Monthly Precipitation of the Driest Quarter (bio17)
ebv_metric_17.:long_name: Average monthly precipitation during the driest 3-month period of the year

ebv_metric_18.:standard_name: Mean Monthly Precipitation of the Warmest Quarter (bio18)
ebv_metric_18.:long_name: Average monthly precipitation during the warmest 3-month period of the year

ebv_metric_19.:standard_name: Mean Monthly Precipitation of the Coldest Quarter (bio19)
ebv_metric_19.:long_name: Average monthly precipitation during the coldest 3-month period of the year
